body.statement: There is an oracle-polynomial-time algorithm for the following weak constrained convex minimization problem: given a positive rational accuracy \(\epsilon\), a centered convex body \((K;n,R,r,a_0)\) through a weak-membership oracle, and a convex function \(f:\mathbb R^n\to\mathbb R\) through an oracle returning rational values to requested rational accuracy, output \(y\in S(K,\epsilon)\) such that \(f(y)\le f(x)+\epsilon\) for every \(x\in S(K,-\epsilon)\).
